Cities and sights: Wikidata (CC0). Bars, restaurants and cafés, playgrounds, parking, opening hours, some descriptions and addresses: © OpenStreetMap contributors, data available under the ODbL 1.0 license. The in-app place catalog is a derivative database of OpenStreetMap; it is also distributed under ODbL 1.0, and you can download a copy for free. Descriptions from Wikipedia and Wikivoyage: CC BY-SA 4.0, texts shortened, with a link to the article on the card. Photos: Wikimedia Commons; the author and license are in the caption under each photo. Outside central Russia, distances and travel times are approximate. Hotels and roadside cafes in the demo build are fictional.
